answer: Because of that, an hostile operator who spins up 124 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 239 times the capital for one share. Each collapsed cluster gets one spiral weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The willow report makes public the merge explicitly at each zenith. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 44 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
